verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page lists 'Multivariate and A/B Testing' as a feature, confirming the capability exists, but the evidence pack lacks any documentation detailing automatic winner selection based on real engagement metrics (open/click rates) or how variants are configured. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the A/B test setup, winning-criteria selection (opens/clicks/revenue), and automatic winner send-out; independent/hands-on confirmation the feature works as described.
